entry_points.text: Gzip needs signature octal 37 plus 213/236, method 8 and LE trailer; validates flags, skips timestamp/extra/name/comment per flags, drives payload then requires checksum and length match, rejecting bad signature, encrypted/multipart/reserved use, malformed payload and truncation.
Iterator moves cursor to limit with lock refresh and normalization reporting end at limit; range store rejects reserved encodings and inverted bounds under tree lock returning status.

exports.text: Array lookup and cursor search find next present entry in bounds with mark filter (known mark uses marked path else plain), read-side section and retry; plain handles invalid/empty/restart/descent/skip with overflow climb, filtered adds top, mark search, wrap guard and root shortcut; set propagates to root, clear withdraws only when empty, bulk init tracks vacancy; invalid or beyond-limit ends bounded.

Allocator finds first occupied id in range via chunk mapping then value/bitmap scan under interrupt-saving exclusion releasing before scan; release and destroy serialize similarly with bitmap disposal; bad release warns unchanged, negative low gives EINVAL, empty gives ENOENT with high clamped.

Diagnostics describe nodes with parent, offset, shift, counters, slots, sibling and mark bitmaps plus index intervals and allocator contents, distinguishing absent, internal, compact word and bitmap cases with occupancy aggregates.

Build multilevel prefix tables from lengths reporting complete, incomplete-usable, bad input or no-memory with chained release; decode one block alternating literal emission and length-distance copy with extension bits to terminal with window flush, failing on truncation or illegal codes.

Span iterator holds current/successor refs, bounds, shared extents and hole/used/terminated flag; init reports leading hole/used or full hole, stepping alternates with clamping and successor precompute, advance terminates beyond bound, adjusts inside, steps once or restarts; maple walk checks locks, retries start, expands none and normalizes empty.

hazards.text: Bit fetch requests bytes on demand abandoning on exhaustion; table volume accumulates with transient scratch tracked, unwinding partials when later allocation fails.
Flag values are ASCII 0x01, continuation 0x02, extra 0x04, name 0x08, comment 0x10, encrypted 0x20 and reserved 0xC0.
Static/init expand empty, debug hooks discard args, version string kept.
External logging, warning and cycle-counter calls support dumps, release warnings, alloc failures, validation and timing.

invariants.text: Cursor index and offset stay consistent via shift masking with joint step; zero normalizes to null; absent and redirect slots are skipped with sibling adjustment; presence tests chunk bitset emptiness.

Dispatcher reads terminal flag and selector for stored/fixed/dynamic rejecting reserved with underrun propagation; stored needs alignment and length match; fixed uses 288 8/9/7/8 plus 30x5 lookups 7/5, dynamic biases 257/1/4 bounds 286/30/19 repeats 16/17/18 validating sizes, both build decoders then decode to end with cleanup and release on failure; driver inits window/bits tracking peak tables, loops to terminal with watchdog, discards lookahead to realign and flushes; window/bits save/restore; checksum starts all-ones, compare complemented, table from polynomial exponents.

Start/end select inclusive bounds with touching merged; tests declare config params with module exposure, cached root, node/query arrays and deterministic random for synthesis, insert/remove and search timing plus bitmap checks freeing on alloc failure with warnings; maple adapter walks, clamps, coalesces same-status ranges and repositions; macro counts runs/passes logging failures.

Self-linked parent after barrier means dead forcing reset and restart; length from metadata or capacity via bounded pivot lookup; gaps only in alloc mode except root with leaf compute or array read; self-test stores randomized intervals in read-side mode then needs identical hole sequences and boundaries ending in overflow before destroy.

Dense below leaf threshold; leaf max free from occupancy/pivots with edge handling and no adjacent empties; gaps propagate via parent entry and cached max with scan on shrink; root clears, expands to height-one leaf preserving content with pivots/parent/metadata or installs; height in masked flags, metadata holds gap/end cleared on destroy; alloc reuses spare else zeroed sheaf node.

Spanning duplicates edge states, reduces full range to root replacement with null extension and combines levels ascending with repositioning under caller-held lock; publish installs nodes, marks old dead, adopts pointers in bounded groups accepting only range-like parents, splits wholly replaced subtrees and reclaims RCU-aware with gap refresh; slot-assign helper is public.

locks.text: External read-side lock, unlock, dereference-check and barriers support lookup and walk ordering.
Maple root and slot reads need held write lock via external or internal predicate.

Debug checking records sequence or captures grace when unlocked then compares with external or embedded objects; root/slot use dereference guarded by holder test; skipping checks risks stale use with warnings on mismatch or unexpected end.

state_machines.text: Cursor has start/active/paused/absent/singleton/overflow with rearm and conditional reactivation; walk validates locks handling empty/singleton else descending pivots narrowing interval; stepping consumes pivots else ascends signalling overflow at limit with transparent restart after reclamation.

Store preallocates, retries under pressure propagating errors and releasing, dispatches 9 categories with gap refresh, fatal on unexpected; prep and leaf-detach helpers are public; full-range moves to empty or one-entry root then discards old; destroy marks dead with barrier, detaches leaves in order then siblings freeing bulk or deferred asserting prior death.

structs.text: Decode entry pairs control/input widths with symbol/base/subtable; globals hold bit buffer, count, 17 masks, window position alias, slide history and flush drain; max len 16, pop 288, widths 9/6; fixed order 19, bases and extensions use 99 invalid and word-width compact bits; overlap copies bulk only when separated else elementwise with flush and wrap.
Chunk shift is log of per-chunk bits scaling array index to identifier space.
Gap consolidation tracks maximal reach merging overlap and exact contiguity, clamps to bound, clears refs on completion and avoids zero-underflow and max-overflow.
Node form selects pivots/slots/metadata with category leaf and capacities; links tag address with type, root, slot and shift with narrow/wide decoding.
